::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--expect_cells`
:::

Expected number of recovered cells, used as input to cell calling algorithm.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Example]{.arg-key} `3000`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--force_cells`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Force pipeline to use this number of cells, bypassing cell calling algorithm.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Example]{.arg-key} `3000`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--chemistry`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Assay configuration.

- auto: autodetect mode
- threeprime: Single Cell 3'
- fiveprime: Single Cell 5'
- SC3Pv1: Single Cell 3' v1
  NOTE: this mode cannot be auto-detected. It must be set explicitly with this option.
- SC3Pv2: Single Cell 3' v2
- SC3Pv3: Single Cell 3' v3
- SC3Pv4: Single Cell 3' v4
- SC3Pv3LT: Single Cell 3' v3 LT
- SC3Pv3HT: Single Cell 3' v3 HT
- SC5P-R2-v3: Single Cell 5', paired-end/R2-only
- SC5P-PE-v3: Single Cell 5' paired-end v3 (GEM-X)
- SC5P-PE: Single Cell 5' paired-end
- SC5P-R2: Single Cell 5' R2-only
- SC-FB: Single Cell Antibody-only 3' v2 or 5'
- ARC-v1: for analyzing the Gene Expression portion of Multiome data.
  NOTE: when the pipeline auto-detects ARC-v1 chemistry, an error is triggered.

See https://kb.10xgenomics.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003764132-How-does-Cell-Ranger-auto-detect-chemistry- for more information.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"auto"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"auto"`, `"threeprime"`, `"fiveprime"`, `"SC3Pv1"`, `"SC3Pv2"`, `"SC3Pv3"`, `"SC3Pv4"`, `"SC3Pv3LT"`, `"SC3Pv3HT"`, `"SC5P-PE-v3"`, `"SC5P-PE"`, `"SC5P-R2"`, `"SC5P-R2-v3"`, `"SC-FB"`, `"ARC-v1"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/mapping/cellranger_count/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/mapping/cellranger_count);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/mapping/cellranger_count/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
